how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-stranglethorn-vale-02.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:571:obj:0: Bring an Aged Gorilla Sinew to Far Seer Mok'thardin in Grom'gol.
rows.quest:571:details:0: What I need from you now will be very difficult to obtain.
rows.quest:571:details:1: BTo hold all these feathers, claws and the pristine fang in place I require a magical tether. Only an aged gorilla sinew will work.
rows.quest:571:details:2: BYou will only be able to find one on an Elder Mistvale Gorilla. They are known to forage to the east of Booty Bay.
rows.quest:571:details:3: BThe sinew must be perfect. It might take quite a few kills for you to find exactly what I need but it will be well worth the hunt.
rows.quest:571:completion:0: A most ideal sinew, ⟦1⟧. Your efforts will pay off soon.
rows.quest:572:obj:0: Bring 10 ⟦E1⟧ Feathers to Far Seer Mok'thardin at the Grom'gol base camp.
rows.quest:572:details:0: The items you gathered from the feline beasts of the Vale are only the first requirement for a powerful enchanted item. These jungle trinkets combined with my shamanistic ritual will provide you with a very useful tool in assisting the ⟦E2⟧ and the Warchief.
rows.quest:572:details:1: BBut now you must gather for me some ⟦E1⟧ Feathers. The feathers are traditionally worn by the beasts on their armbands. You will find a tribe of the raptors directly south of Grom'gol, not far from the great arena.
rows.quest:572:completion:0: Most excellent. I will prepare these at once.
rows.quest:573:obj:0: Far Seer Mok'thardin of Grom'gol needs Holy Spring Water. He also wants you to kill 10 Naga Explorers.
rows.quest:573:details:0: There is but one final reagent needed to complete the enchantment.
rows.quest:573:details:1: BIn the south, towards the western coast, high above the bluffs, lies a Holy Spring. This spring is the subject of great conflict amongst religious and mystical scholars. Every race in ⟦E3⟧ claims that the spring waters were made divine for their people.
rows.quest:573:details:2: BMy final request of you: bring to me Holy Spring Water. Be warned. An expedition of naga explorers have advanced upon the spring. They will need to be dealt with as well.
rows.quest:573:completion:0: With this Holy Spring Water the ceremonial choker is ready for enchantment.
rows.quest:573:completion:1: BWear this with pride, ⟦2⟧, in the name of the Warchief and in defense of the mighty ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:574:obj:0: Kill 10 Kurzen Commandoes and 6 Kurzen Headshrinkers.
rows.quest:574:obj:1: BReport to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.
rows.quest:574:details:0: Now that many of his regular troops are reduced, you must face his highly trained forces. When they're not in the wilderness slaughtering our rebel soldiers, they are found deep in the back of the Kurzen Compound, in a cave they call the Stockpile.
rows.quest:574:details:1: BI know many of Kurzen's troops personally, and I know they are skilled, loyal, and cruel. This is no easy task I set before you, ⟦3⟧.
rows.quest:574:details:2: BAfter you defeat them, report to Lieutenant Doren, my commanding officer. He will want your report firsthand.
rows.quest:574:completion:0: ⟦4⟧. Sergeant Yohwa trusted your abilities, and I trust her. The defeat you brought to Kurzen's forces is almost too much to hope for. I had feared we rebels were alone, and alone we could never stand up against the Colonel's brilliance.
rows.quest:574:completion:1: BPerhaps hope of our survival yet remains.
rows.quest:575:obj:0: Bring 2 Large River Crocolisk Skins to Drizzlik in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:575:details:0: "The finest leathercrafter of the South Seas and the worlds old and new." That's what they call me. Me! Drizzlik! The finest lea... Ahem. Well.
rows.quest:575:details:1: BMy leather goods are known far and wide as the most exquisite, a connoisseur's choice!
rows.quest:575:details:2: BI've just received an order from Director Riddlevox of the Tinkers' Union for a dozen of his favorite Excelsior-line boots. Our best sellers, actually.
rows.quest:575:details:3: BTo start on the basic shape, I'll need crocolisk skins from the crocs along the river in northern Stranglethorn.
rows.quest:575:completion:0: These skins should do. Their quality isn't too important, given that they'll make up the inside layer of the boots, but it's still important that they're comfortable.
rows.quest:575:completion:1: BIf they're a bit too rigid, I'll use some tiger blood to soften it up. Tricks o' the trade, you know?
rows.quest:576:obj:0: Dizzy One-Eye in Booty Bay wants you to retrieve his eye from the Bloodsail Buccaneers.
rows.quest:576:details:1: BArgh, I am but useless without me special enchanted eye. Bad enough to have lost me eyes in battle in the first place! But by some stroke o' luck we docked in Menethil and a traveling wizard enchanted a special glass eye that let me see again.
rows.quest:576:details:2: BLast night I ended up gettin' jumped by some Bloodsail Buccaneers on me way out. Took me eye, they did! Seems those blokes have found their way to Booty Bay.
rows.quest:576:details:3: BHelp an old sea dog out by gettin' me eye back?
rows.quest:576:completion:0: Shiver me timbers and timber me shivers! Ye found me beautiful eye! Let's see if she still fits.
rows.quest:576:completion:1: BShavas ho! Blimey, I can see!!
rows.quest:577:obj:0: Bring 5 Snapjaw Crocolisks Skins to Drizzlik in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:577:details:0: Well, I've got the basic shape of the boots worked out, and they're coming along fine, but the skins you brought aren't going to be quite enough for the inner layers.
rows.quest:577:details:1: B"What are we going to do, Drizzlik?" No doubt the question on your lips, and well, isn't it lucky you're talking to Drizzlik, because he's going to tell you what we're going to do!
rows.quest:577:details:2: BThe inner layers will never really be seen, so we'll just get some of the thicker, cheaper skins from the crocs around Lake Nazferiti to fill the boots out.
rows.quest:577:completion:0: My boots... they're like sausages, ⟦5⟧. Look great, taste great. I tell you they're filled with nothing but the finest ingredients and meats, and you eat it, and you love it.
rows.quest:577:completion:1: BIt's safer--and more enjoyable--if you just trust me, and don't ask too carefully what's really inside.
rows.quest:578:obj:0: Find the haunted island for Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:578:details:0: If there is indeed a goblin mage and water elementals haunting the island, it could mean the Stone of the Tides can be mine!
rows.quest:578:details:1: BI want you to locate this haunted island... find out what's going on. Oh, and if you perhaps want to find out more about the Stone of the Tides, take this scrip to the ⟦E4⟧ Library, they should be able to find you a copy of the book I first came across the legend in.
rows.quest:578:details:2: BCould it be that Gazban actually discovered the Stone...?
rows.quest:578:completion:0: So the stories were true! Incredible!
rows.quest:578:completion:1: BHowever, we will need to figure out a way to defeat the curse of the Stone of the Tides, if we are to retrieve it. The curse is magical business, we'll need one of those wizards to help us out.
rows.quest:580:obj:0: Whiskey Slim in Booty Bay wants you to bring him the bottles of Pupellyverbos Port he lost.
rows.quest:580:details:0: We was splicin' the mainbrace somethin' fierce off of the Overlook Cliffs, ol' Hinterlands just in the distance. Thought the seas was goin' to swallow us whole.
rows.quest:580:details:1: BOl' Slim knows all about liquid courage! Cap'n had a crate of Pupellyverbos Port we commandeered from a privateer en route to ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:580:details:2: BSo when that storm off of Hinterlands hit, I busted into the grog. Big wave hit and tossed them bottles overboard. Cap'n is goin' to give me a taste o' the cat if ye don't help me get 'em back though!
rows.quest:580:completion:0: Shiver me timbers! Ye found the Cap'n's grog!
rows.quest:580:completion:1: BI owe ye big time, friend.
rows.quest:580:completion:2: BSeems like a storm is a brewin' outside. Maybe I'll just keep warm with one o' these here bottles while we wait for it to pass....
rows.quest:581:obj:0: Bring 9 Bloodscalp Tusks to ⟦E5⟧ at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
rows.quest:581:details:0: A doom, there is. A doom on my chief's youngest son, Yenniku. As is a custom with our people, he was given to the Gurubashi Trolls of Zul'Gurub, but after my tribe, the ⟦E6⟧ tribe, left with the orc Thrall, poor Yenniku was lost to us. I was sent from distant ⟦E7⟧, back to Stranglethorn, to search for my chief's son.
rows.quest:581:details:1: BAnd I believe the Bloodscalp tribe has him.
rows.quest:581:details:2: BIf you would help me, then hunt the Bloodscalps. You may find them to the north. Gather their tusks and return to me.
rows.quest:581:completion:0: These are good tusks, ⟦6⟧. You prove that you have the strength to hunt the Bloodscalps.
rows.quest:581:completion:1: BAnd that is good, because you are not done hunting them.
rows.quest:582:obj:0: Bring 20 Shrunken Heads to ⟦E5⟧ at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
rows.quest:582:details:0: We must find if Yenniku is dead.
rows.quest:582:details:1: BSlay the Bloodscalp Headhunters and take from them their Shrunken Heads. You must gather many, many heads, and I will inspect them to make sure Yenniku's head is not among them.
rows.quest:582:details:2: BAnd if Yenniku was killed by the Bloodscalps, then may a 600-year curse fall on the spirit of their chief, Gan'zulah!
rows.quest:582:details:3: BGo, ⟦7⟧. You may find many Headhunters at the ruins of Zuuldaia and Zul'Kunda, along the coast to the north.
rows.quest:582:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦8⟧. I will inspect these heads to ensure poor Yenniku was spared the headhunter's axe.
rows.quest:583:details:1: BPerhaps you're not aware of this, but that dwarf over there is the one and only Hemet Nesingwary, renowned war hero of the ⟦E8⟧ and master big game hunter. He's not one for welcoming strangers into his camp, but you look like you've seen quite a bit of action in your day, ⟦9⟧.
rows.quest:583:details:2: BBeing a veteran of many battles himself, Master Nesingwary has a soft spot for fellow heroes.
rows.quest:583:details:3: BGo and speak with him. Perhaps he can give you some hunting pointers.
rows.quest:583:completion:0: Jolly nice to make your acquaintance, ⟦10⟧. Haven't seen a ⟦11⟧ around these parts for some time.
rows.quest:583:completion:1: BI situated myself with this expedition for one purpose: to hunt a great and elusive beast. Seeing that you're a hero of sorts I am willing to let you take part in the hunt, but you must first prove yourself.
rows.quest:583:completion:2: BI shall teach the ways of raptor killing to you. Ajeck will train you with tiger hunting. And Sir Erlgadin is a master of panther tracking.
rows.quest:583:completion:3: BProve your skill and I'll let you in on the big hunt.
rows.quest:584:obj:0: Bring Gan'zulah's Head and Nezzliok's Head to the bubbling cauldron at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
rows.quest:584:details:0: Yenniku was not among the heads, and I thank the Great Serpent for it. But we are no closer to finding him.
rows.quest:584:details:1: BWe must know the truth, and I fear that only the Bloodscalp chief and his witchdoctor know it. They are the enemies of the ⟦E6⟧ tribe and will not speak freely, so we must force the truth from their dead lips!
rows.quest:584:details:2: BBring me the heads of Gan'zulah and Nezzliok the Dire and place them within this cauldron.
rows.quest:584:details:3: BThey are deep within Zul'Kunda. Bring their heads...we will then make them talk.
rows.quest:584:completion:0: You place the heads of Gan'zulah and Nezzliok within the cauldron...
rows.quest:585:obj:0: Bring a Balia'mah Trophy, a Ziata'jai Trophy and a Zul'Mamwe Trophy to the Bubbling Cauldron at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
rows.quest:585:details:1: BIt is true. I know where the child of the Darkspears was taken. You have bested me and bound my spirit, but I will say nothing without appeasement!
rows.quest:585:details:2: BThe Bloodscalps war with the Skullsplitters. To gain my favor, steal from the Skullsplitters 3 of their trophy skulls and place them here with us, so that my spirit will have slaves in the Nether. One skull must be from their trophy pile in Balia'mah, another from Ziata'jai, and the last from Zul'Mamwe.
rows.quest:585:completion:0: Yes. These will serve me well. When my spirit is freed, I will enter the Nether with three fine servants!
rows.quest:585:completion:1: BYou are a credit to your ⟦13⟧ clan, and you have appeased me.
rows.quest:586:obj:0: Kill 8 Skullsplitter Hunters, 6 Skullsplitter Headhunters, and 4 Skullsplitter Berserkers.
rows.quest:586:obj:1: BBring the Broken Armor of Ana'thek to the Bubbling Cauldron at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
rows.quest:586:details:1: BCurse you! And curse your ancestors!!
rows.quest:586:details:2: BOnly blood and revenge can cool my rage, so if that is your wish, then... do this:
rows.quest:586:details:3: BThrow yourself into the heart of the Skullsplitters to the east. Slay the fiercest among them, and if you survive...then break yourself against their chief, Ana'thek the Cruel. Hah! Bring me his shattered armor if you can!
rows.quest:586:details:4: BMay he tear off your limbs and leave you to rot and be eaten by carrion.
rows.quest:586:completion:0: I do not want to believe it, but I cannot deny what you have done. And my rage eases, now that Ana'thek is defeated.
rows.quest:586:completion:1: BYour might will drive you to great deeds, ⟦15⟧. But one day...I will see you in the Nether and we will again match strength.
rows.quest:587:obj:0: Deeg in Booty Bay wants you to bring him 15 shares of Snuff.
rows.quest:587:details:0: Ah, the sea life. I ain't gonna say it's the good life, but it's my life.
rows.quest:587:details:1: BWhen I get into port I like to find me a good bottle of grog and some high quality snuff. Nasty habits but what's a pirate without his vices, right?
rows.quest:587:details:2: BSo you can imagine how heartbroken I was to find out the herbalist here in town has gone and sold out of the stuff. Says his shipment got hijacked by those damned Bloodsail Raiders.
rows.quest:587:details:3: BI bet a fearless ⟦16⟧ like you could convince 'em to share the goods, eh?
rows.quest:587:completion:0: Good show, ⟦17⟧! And just before I need to ship out too! Can't thank you enough, old friend.
rows.quest:588:details:1: BYou have appeased myself and my chief, so I will tell you that which you seek to discover...
rows.quest:588:details:2: BYoung Yenniku is lost to his clan.
rows.quest:588:details:3: BHe was taken by the witchdoctor Zanzil the Outcast. Now Zanzil controls him, body and soul, and only the most potent magic could set him free.
rows.quest:588:details:4: BA magic that you do not have, ⟦19⟧.
rows.quest:588:details:5: BPerhaps your ⟦E6⟧ allies can offer a hope of Yenniku's ⟦E9⟧. But that, I doubt.
rows.quest:588:completion:1: BIf Yenniku is held by that troll, a vile and powerful witchdoctor, then I fear that only a faint hope remains. Faint. And tiny as the smallest insect.
rows.quest:589:obj:0: Bring 3 Pulsing Blue Shards to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
rows.quest:589:details:0: Legends tell of a jewel, hidden deep in the heart of Stranglethorn. We call it the Mind's Eye, and it has great powers. If you gain this Eye then, perhaps, we can use it to bring lost Yenniku back from the darkness.
rows.quest:589:details:1: BI will consult with the spirits of the jungle to find the Mind's Eye. While I do this, you enter the Crystalvein Mine, southeast of here, and gather Pulsing Blue Shards from Ironjaw Basilisks. The shards are rare, but we will need their magic to bend the Mind's Eye to our will.
rows.quest:589:completion:0: You have done well, ⟦20⟧. These shards are well formed. Already I hear them sing to me.
rows.quest:589:completion:1: BAnd while you were gone, I spoke with the spirits of the jungle. I know where the Mind's Eye rests...
rows.quest:591:obj:0: Bring the Mind's Eye to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
rows.quest:591:details:0: The Mind's Eye is held by an ogre mage, east of here and deep within the Mosh'Ogg ogre mound. His name is Mai'Zoth. I know him from when the Darkspears dwelt in Stranglethorn - he is vicious, and his magic is strong.
rows.quest:591:details:1: BAnd if he has the Mind's Eye, then his magic will be stronger still.
rows.quest:591:details:2: BYou must face Mai'Zoth and wrest from him the Mind's Eye. It is a perilous task, but it is the only hope we have of saving Yenniku.
rows.quest:591:completion:0: You retrieved the eye! Your might is the stuff of legends, ⟦21⟧!
rows.quest:591:completion:1: BAnd in getting the Eye, you must have defeated Mai'Zoth and sent him to the Nether. That is why the spirits would not mention him before.
rows.quest:591:completion:2: BIt is good that he is gone from the world of flesh and bone, but now that he is in the realm of spirits...I fear he will begin a new reign.
rows.quest:591:completion:3: BBut that is a worry for another time. Now, I must perform a ritual to bend the Mind's Eye to our needs...
rows.quest:592:obj:0: Bring the Filled Soul Gem to ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:592:details:0: I have reshaped the Mind's Eye into a Soul Gem. Its purpose is twofold: you must use it to stun Yenniku, and once stunned place it upon his head to entrap his soul.
rows.quest:592:details:2: BYenniku dwells with Zanzil the Outcast, at the Ruins of Aboraz, along the Crystal ⟦E10⟧ on the distant Cape of Stranglethorn.
rows.quest:592:completion:0: You've done it! You freed Yenniku from the will of Zanzil, and completed the mission I had thought was so desperate.
rows.quest:592:completion:1: BOur tribe will remember your name in songs, ⟦22⟧, and we will etch your tale in stone so that it will live forever.
rows.quest:594:obj:0: Find the author of the message in a bottle.
rows.quest:594:details:0: The note reads, in fairly good handwriting:
rows.quest:594:details:1: BTo any that can aid me-
rows.quest:594:details:2: BPlease, my need for help is dire. A great Skymane holds me captive on an island in the South Seas.
rows.quest:594:details:3: BThe stars at night are foreign to me and obscured by the jungle trees, but on the clearest days I see Wild ⟦E10⟧ to the northwest, and what seem to be large sailing ships to the southwest.
rows.quest:594:details:4: BI beg of you, my would-be savior, please help me.
rows.quest:594:completion:0: Have you come to free me?
rows.quest:595:obj:0: First Mate Crazz wants you to check the cove north of Booty Bay.
rows.quest:595:details:0: You sure seem eager to work, matey. Not sure why some land-loving ⟦23⟧ ⟦24⟧ is offering help to the Blackwater Raiders, but I'm not going to turn you away.
rows.quest:595:details:1: BOur ship just docked here in Booty Bay and word has it that our rivals--those damned, dirty Bloodsail Buccaneers--have been spotted all over southern Stranglethorn.
rows.quest:595:details:2: BAll the boys are too busy hitting the grog and looking for ladies! What I need is a scout.
rows.quest:595:details:3: BCheck the cove just north of Booty Bay along the Savage Coast and see what you find.
rows.quest:595:completion:0: Inside the skiff, you discover a map with some hastily written text on it along with some coins.
rows.quest:596:obj:0: Bring 25 Bloody Bone Necklaces to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base Camp.
rows.quest:596:details:0: I was sent to Grom'gol to aid ⟦E5⟧ on his quest, but... I too have reasons for being here.
rows.quest:596:details:1: BThe Bloodscalp tribe is enemy to our tribe. Collecting trophies of our enemies gives us power over them. You may aid our tribe by hunting our enemies.
rows.quest:596:details:2: BThey dwell to the north. Slay Bloodscalp trolls and take from them their bloody bone necklaces. Collect many, and your reward will be great.
rows.quest:596:completion:0: Ah, very good. I will boil these, and leech them, and the spirits of their owners will weaken as I render their necklaces to paste!
rows.quest:596:completion:1: BHere, ⟦25⟧. This will repay my debt to you.
rows.quest:597:obj:0: Report your findings to First Mate Crazz in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:597:details:0: The map shows Booty Bay with a red "X" drawn precisely at the spot at which you are standing.
rows.quest:597:details:2: B"You men are to secure a camp at this location and keep quiet. Wait for the signal from the southern command post before attacking. If anyone approaches you, kill them."
rows.quest:597:completion:0: Sure, I remember you, ⟦26⟧. Back from scouting I see....
rows.quest:598:obj:0: Bring 25 Split Bone Necklaces to Kin'weelay at the Grom'gol Base camp.
rows.quest:598:details:0: Now that you have gathered Bloodscalp trophies, I have another task for you. The Skullsplitter tribe of trolls live to the southeast, and for years we have warred with them. Although the Darkspears no longer dwell in Stranglethorn, we are bound to our conflict with the Skullsplitters.
rows.quest:598:details:1: BSo, hunt them. Gather their Split Bone Necklaces and return to me. Aid us in our war, and you will earn the friendship of the Darkspears.
rows.quest:598:completion:0: Your strength is great to have gained these necklaces, ⟦27⟧. The Skullsplitters fall to you like young saplings stomped to earth by a Basilisk!
rows.quest:598:completion:1: BYour deeds are a boon to us.
rows.quest:599:obj:0: Report the planned Bloodsail attack to Fleet Master Seahorn.
rows.quest:599:details:0: Shiver me timbers! So the Bloodsail Buccaneers are planning some sort of attack on Booty Bay? Why, the nerve of those scoundrels. Booty Bay will always be run by the Blackwater Raiders!
rows.quest:599:details:1: BThis is bigger than I thought. Report what you have learned to Fleet Master Seahorn at once! The ol' sea dog is around town somewhere....
rows.quest:599:completion:0: Bloodsail Buccaneers attacking Booty Bay? They might as well throw themselves off the Overlook Cliffs. Nonetheless, by bringing me this information you have done my fleet of swashbucklers a great service. The Blackwater Raiders thank you.
rows.quest:600:obj:0: Bring 10 Singing Blue Crystals to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:600:details:0: The Venture Company has a string of operations through Stranglethorn which keeps hard-working goblins, like me, from making honest gold! Please, you must help me!
rows.quest:600:details:1: BThe Venture Company is mining near the Crystalvein Mine to the north. They can't get into the mine because of all the basilisks, but they're still able to dig up Singing Crystals from the surrounding hills.
rows.quest:600:details:2: BTake their crystals from them, and show them they don't have the run of the jungle.
rows.quest:600:details:3: BAnd... um... bring me those crystals as proof!
rows.quest:600:completion:0: Great! Wonderful! I can get a bundle for these!!
rows.quest:600:completion:1: BThat Venture Company sure picked the wrong jungle to mine in, didn't they? We'd all be in better shape if they moved out of here.
rows.quest:600:completion:2: BThank you, ⟦28⟧. You've done a good deed this day.
rows.quest:601:obj:0: Acquire 6 ⟦E11⟧ Bracers for Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:601:details:0: The water elementals were no doubt summoned by Gazban, the goblin wizard rumored to have discovered the Stone of the Tides. As you may know, the Stone of the Tides curses its bearer, causing him to fade in and out of existence...
rows.quest:601:details:1: BPerhaps we can find a way to counteract the curse. We can have a mage of ⟦E12⟧ analyze the magical residue of one of the water elemental's bracers. I need you to go back to the island and retrieve a few specimens.
rows.quest:601:completion:0: Hm, I haven't the eye to examine these bracers to see if any of them will be of any use, but I'm sure at least one of them will be able to help. Take them to ⟦E12⟧ and have a mage look at them.
rows.quest:601:completion:1: BAfter all, I can't very well leave Booty Bay just to chat with those tiresome old mages.
rows.quest:601:completion:2: BNot that I'm worried anyone would try to elbow their way into being the new baron. No one crosses Revilgaz and lives to tell of it.
rows.quest:602:obj:0: Bring the water elemental bracers to Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver in ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:602:details:0: From what I've heard, the mages of ⟦E12⟧ are busy with the reconstruction of their destroyed city, I'm sure you can find one of them who will spare some time to look at the bracers. If there's anything I know about mages, they can't resist a magical puzzle.
rows.quest:602:details:1: BTake the bag of water elemental bracers and see if they can shed any light on the Stone's curse. Look for the Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver in particular. I've dealt with him before, and his knowledge is vast.
rows.quest:602:completion:0: The Stone of the Tides? Most interesting. It might surprise you to know that I wrote a tome - several years ago - pertaining to the legends of the Gurubashi Empire. I do know quite a bit about the Stone.
rows.quest:602:completion:1: BAt least one of these bracers appears to have some magical residue I can analyze.
rows.quest:602:completion:2: BLet's see what I can see...
rows.quest:603:obj:0: Talk to Catelyn in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:603:details:0: The mage that is in possession of the Stone is amplifying its power through some focal point... an altar of some sort. You should be able to disrupt it by overpowering it.
rows.quest:603:details:1: BAs it happens, I know just the thing: an ancient dagger, another troll relic. There's just one... little problem.
rows.quest:603:details:2: BYou see, I found the dagger while researching in Stranglethorn, but I gave it to my willful daughter, Catelyn, who ran off to Booty Bay to become a pirate.
rows.quest:603:completion:0: My dagger? What are you, some sort of comedian?
rows.quest:603:completion:1: BWhat? Do you just want me to repeat the story of how I've gone from the best knife fighter in Booty Bay to the laughing stock of piratedom!
rows.quest:603:completion:2: BI lost a knife fight to one of the Bloodsail Buccaneers--bunch of right bastards they are!--and he took my blade as spoils.
rows.quest:603:completion:3: BIt's not as though I can get by as a knife fighter with insults and a sharp tongue alone...
rows.quest:604:obj:0: Fleet Master Seahorn in Booty Bay wants you to kill 10 Bloodsail Swashbucklers and bring back the Bloodsail Charts and the Bloodsail Orders.
rows.quest:604:details:0: Crazz speaks highly of your dedication to the Blackwater Raiders. I am going to trust you with a mission of extreme importance to the fleet.
rows.quest:604:details:1: BInfiltrate the so-called southern command post the Bloodsail Buccaneers have established on the Wild ⟦E10⟧. Raid the encampment. Bring me their charts along with their written orders. We shall see exactly what those scum are up to.
rows.quest:604:completion:0: Perfect, ⟦29⟧. Now that we know their plan, it's just a matter of time.
rows.quest:604:completion:1: BAnd to think the fools have dropped anchor just off the cape....
rows.quest:605:obj:0: Bring 10 Singing Crystal Shards to Crank Fizzlebub.
rows.quest:605:details:0: The Singing Crystals are unique to Stranglethorn, and are very valuable to certain parties. I can move those crystals, but the cursed Venture Company makes it hard for an honest entrepreneur like myself to gather any!
rows.quest:605:details:2: BThe basilisks in Stranglethorn eat the crystal. This gives them their hardened skin, and sometimes decent quality crystal can be harvested from it.
rows.quest:605:details:3: BYou can get it from any basilisk, but the less nasty ones are along the shores south of Zul'Kunda, to the north.
rows.quest:605:completion:0: Aha! These will do nicely, ⟦30⟧. Yes, quite nicely!
rows.quest:605:completion:1: BHere is your cut, and...it was a pleasure doing business with you.
rows.quest:606:obj:0: Bring 5 Mistvale Giblets to "Shaky" Phillipe in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:606:details:0: If there's one thing I can't stand, it's people who don't pay their gambling debts! And there are a lot of people who owe me. Think you can help me collect?
rows.quest:606:details:1: BFirst, there's "Shaky" Phillipe down by the docks. He owes me plenty after last week's game and I want my due! But to get it, we'll have to scare him.
rows.quest:606:details:2: BGo out of town and hunt Elder Mistvale Gorillas. Find a nice selection of giblets, then take them to Shaky. Don't let on that they're from an animal; let him think the worst.
rows.quest:606:completion:0: Ack! Where'd you get these? No, don't tell me. I don't want to know!
rows.quest:607:obj:0: Bring Shaky's Payment to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley.
rows.quest:607:details:0: Here, take this pouch and give it to Sea Wolf. And tell him I meant to pay him back! I swear!!
rows.quest:607:details:1: BI just got a little drunk and lost my way, and...you know how things are. He'll understand - you don't have to get rough!
rows.quest:607:completion:0: Heh heh, well done! And when you showed Shaky those giblets, how hard did he shake?
rows.quest:607:completion:1: BHah! He's so easy to read, when I play cards with him I can't help but win!
rows.quest:607:completion:2: BThanks for your help, ⟦31⟧. Now it's your turn to get paid...
rows.quest:608:obj:0: Fleet-Master Seahorn in Booty Bay wants you to kill Captain Stillwater, Captain Keelhaul and Fleet Master Firallon.
rows.quest:608:details:0: Blast the nerve of Firallon! He couldn't sail a skiff through Crystal Lake let alone lead an entire fleet against us.
rows.quest:608:details:1: BThe Bloodsail Buccaneers will pay for their carelessness. Now that we know their plan of attack, we can counter before they know what hit them.
rows.quest:608:details:2: BBut why send the entire fleet to do the work of one brave adventuring party? ⟦32⟧, take some of your most skilled comrades out to Firallon's landing spot and assassinate the Bloodsail leadership. Their fleet will sink soon after....
rows.quest:608:completion:0: Ah, what a great day for the Blackwater Raiders! Three cheers to you, ⟦33⟧!
rows.quest:609:obj:0: Bring Maury's Clubbed Foot, Jon-Jon's Golden Spyglass, and Chucky's Huge Ring to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:609:details:0: My list is shortening, but there are still people who owe me.
rows.quest:609:details:1: BNext, we have Maury "Club Foot" Wilkins, Jon-Jon the Crow, and Chucky "Ten Thumbs."
rows.quest:609:details:2: BThese scurvy dogs' debts are months outstanding and I thought they skipped town to avoid paying up! Later, I heard they're cursed and bewitched and now wander the jungle ruins. But I don't care what their fate is - I want what's mine!
rows.quest:609:details:3: BThey're at the Ruins of Aboraz and the Ruins of Jubuwal, northeast of here. Find them, and collect.
rows.quest:609:completion:0: Great! I can get a good price for these, especially for what's inside Maury's foot! Thanks much, ⟦34⟧!
rows.quest:609:completion:1: BI hope those three learned their lesson: don't bet something you can't afford to lose.
rows.quest:609:completion:2: BAnd maybe it's too late for them, but...they should be careful of who they gamble with.
rows.quest:610:obj:0: Get Catelyn's dagger from "Pretty Boy" Duncan.
rows.quest:610:details:0: My FATHER sent you? I'd have thought that old codger would have given up on me by now.
rows.quest:610:details:1: BIt wasn't really his fault I ran off, he just shouldn't have expected I'd be willing to live a boring life, reading over musty books and associating with grey-haired, stiff-backed, stuffy mages!
rows.quest:610:details:2: BIf you need my dagger, you'll have to get it back from "Pretty Boy" Duncan, one of the Bloodsail Buccaneers. Put something 'tween his shoulders and I'm sure he'll give it up.
rows.quest:610:completion:0: You beat Duncan? I guess you aren't as wet behind the ears as you looked at first glance.
rows.quest:610:completion:1: BI suppose that also means I shouldn't challenge you to a fight any time soon!
rows.quest:611:obj:0: Destroy the Altar of the Tides with Catelyn's Blade, kill Gazban and bring the Stone of the Tides and Catelyn's Blade back to Baron Revilgaz.
rows.quest:611:details:0: So you're looking for an altar of some sort? Well, I'm no expert on troll ruins like my father, but I have heard about a sunken troll city out near that island you're looking for. Maybe you should try there.
rows.quest:611:details:1: BYou got my knife back for me, so I guess you can borrow it... but I want it back when you're done!
rows.quest:611:completion:0: Amazing! The Stone of Tides! It shall have a place of prominence in my collection of ancient troll artifacts. Did you see how it almost seems as though a tide is trapped within its surface? Magnificent!
rows.quest:613:obj:0: Bring Maury's Key to "Sea Wolf" Mackinley in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:613:details:0: Curses! That swab Maury put a lock on his foot, and I can't open it! His loot's inside the foot, and that's what he owes me!
rows.quest:613:details:1: BWe need to find the key to open the lock. Maury was known to gamble with the Mosh'Ogg ogres, at their mound to the northeast. And he told me, when he was still alive, that the last time he went to the mound he was chased off after winning too much. Maybe the Ogres there have his key.
rows.quest:613:details:2: BBut if they do, you might have to kill a load of them to find the right one...
rows.quest:613:completion:0: You found it! Thanks a million, ⟦35⟧. You've been a big help to me!
rows.quest:613:completion:1: BHere you go - you earned this!
rows.quest:614:obj:0: Bring Smotts' Chest to Hecklebury Smotts in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:614:details:0: I used to sail a ship from here all the way to Ratchet, in ⟦E13⟧. I was a successful captain with a sterling reputation.
rows.quest:614:details:2: BThose cursed sea giants ruined me! They smashed my ship, killed my crew, and set me on a lifeboat to Booty Bay. And one of the giants, Gorlash, stole my Captain's Chest. He said he wanted it for a snuffbox. The nerve!
rows.quest:614:details:3: BI hear Gorlash wanders the coast east of here. Find him and get back my chest! Do that, and you'll have earned a captain's gratitude.
rows.quest:614:completion:0: You found it! Oh happy day, this is! Thank you, ⟦36⟧. Getting back my chest cools some of the fire in me.
